svg.text: Leshy2 · H1-R2.39 · four matched PCB faces
Outer face above; the inner face is shown exactly as viewed after physically turning the PCB over.

g.text: Reviewed R2 exterior. PCB-face free text is silkscreen; drawing notes and arrows are annotations.
• both 80×150-mm panels use the same millimetre scale
• every solid component envelope comes from the MPN register
• shared Cap-Bus rail, vertical host socket and Keystone holder all fit
• exact components clear all M2.5 hole/head keep-outs
• both RF connector banks mount on the outward PCB faces
↑ / ↓ / ← / → interface faces through that enclosure edge
⊗ / ⊙ press toward / remove away from the viewed face
MICROPHONE is front-face silkscreen with a downward arrow; its body remains on the rear PCB.
physical actual-TX evidence for each built-in transmitting path
Nine physical-TX indicators plus FAULT form two aligned rows of five.
Labels match use: WI-FI/BLE, WI-FI/15.4, nRF24-1..3, SUB-GHz, VHF/UHF, IR and LORA/EXT.
orange dashed — open custom enclosure drawing
RF connectors are outward-face bodies with barrels and hex nuts.
SMA: GCT RFPC-SMA31-FN-175-A · 6 GHz · IP67 · 1.6-mm PCB.
RP-SMA: GCT RFPC-SMA32-FN-175-A · same panel cut-out.
Cap-Bus host: Samtec HLE-107-02-G-DV-PE-LC · 2×7 · 2.54 mm · pass-through.
Dimensioned projection — not an enclosure release drawing.
Navigation is five exact OMRON B3S-1100P direct buttons; no custom cap or actuator.
Davies 1227-J is the exact encoder knob; only its fit HIL remains.
The side C&K JS102011SCQN is the sole RUN/KILL and source-command control.
ESP32-LESHY2 · UI PCB · R2-EVT1 · REV A
